text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need a lightweight taxonomy for design-partner feedback so eng + PM can prioritize work without back-and-forth. Proposed labels: bug, regression, quality, ux, infra, feature_request, docs, data. Also thinking severity tiers (P0/P1/P2) and an optional "blocked-by-customer" flag. Thoughts? Link to rough doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder
Jordan: +1. Add severity. Also worth capturing source (survey, session, support-ticket, demo) so we can weight signals.
Mike: Prefer a single "ask" vs "request" field rather than too many fine-grained labels. We can compute an impact score = severity * signal_weight later.
Tara: Can we have a small set of canonical tags for the UI so PMs/recruiters can pick quickly? Too many options cause inconsistency. Also add "blocked-by-customer" as Tara suggested.
Elaine: We should map each label to a rollout gate: immediate-fix / next-sprint / backlog. That makes prioritization actionable for Eng.
Priya: Agreed. Quick proposal: keep 8 labels max, severity P0/P1/P2, source required, backlog_gate inferred from label+severity. Example mapping in doc. Also propose 3 exemplar annotated threads for training.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly dp-signal-sync Thursday 10:00am PT — add mapping review to agenda.
Jordan: I'll draft a 1-pager with the mapping table and a CSV schema: fields -> feedback_id, participant_id, label, severity, source, gate, notes. Will add sample annotated threads.
Mike: For infra: can we wire an export hook so analysts get a nightly CSV and a small dashboard showing top labels by cohort? I can take that.
Tara: Training is key — I'll own a 15-min recruiter/PM playbook + 3 example annotations. We should keep the UI dropdown to top 5 labels and an "other" free-text.
Priya: Owners: Jordan = mapping doc + schema, Tara = training playbook, Mike = export hook/dashboard, Elaine = rollout gate rules. Can we review on Friday?
Elaine: :thumbsup: Booked 11:00am PT Friday in #product — please add notes to the doc beforehand.
Priya: Thanks — will seed the doc with current examples and the proposed mapping table. If folks can add 1 annotated thread each before Friday, we can validate inter-rater consistency. :eyes:
Jordan: I'll add mine now.
Mike: Adding a quick note about impact score computation.
Tara: I'll draft the playbook snippets tonight.
Priya: Great — next sync will finalize the taxonomy and rollout gating logic. :party:
